description: This file defines types and functions for configuring and resolving MCP transport configurations, including HTTP and stdio transports, with support for custom timeouts and transport types.

methods.name: getConnectionTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the connection timeout in milliseconds from raw server data, defaulting to 30,000 ms if not specified or invalid.

methods.name: getRequestedTransport
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the requested transport type from raw server data.

methods.name: resolveHttpTransportConfig
methods.description: Resolves HTTP transport configuration based on server data, including handling headers and URL.

methods.name: resolveMcpTransportConfig
methods.description: Main exported function that resolves the overall MCP transport configuration, prioritizing stdio, then HTTP, with support for specific transport types.
